items: The maintenance supervisor assigned ____ technician to inspect the backup generator.
'Technician' is singular countable and one additional technician is meant, so 'another' is required.
The company sells office furniture and ____ equipment through its online catalog.
'Equipment' is uncountable, so 'other' correctly modifies it.
Some guests requested vegetarian meals, while ____ chose the standard menu.
The blank stands alone for additional plural guests, so 'others' is required.
When the first payment terminal stopped working, the cashier switched to ____ terminal.
'Terminal' is singular countable and a different terminal is meant, so 'another' is required.
The training session covers customer service, safety procedures, and ____ workplace topics.
'Workplace topics' is plural, so 'other' is the correct determiner.
Several departments submitted their budgets early; ____ are still waiting for final cost estimates.
No noun follows the blank, and the verb is plural, so 'others' is required.
The editor asked for ____ draft after finding several inconsistencies in the first version.
'Draft' is singular countable and one revised/additional draft is requested, so 'another' is required.
The new warehouse will store electronics, furniture, and ____ merchandise.
'Merchandise' is uncountable, so 'other' correctly modifies it.
Some applicants applied through the company website; ____ were referred by current employees.
The blank replaces a plural noun phrase, so 'others' is required.
The customer requested ____ appointment because she could not attend on Tuesday.
'Appointment' is singular countable and a different appointment is meant, so 'another' is required.
Please compare this month's revenue with ____ financial indicators before revising the forecast.
'Financial indicators' is plural, so 'other' is required.
A number of stores already use the new checkout system, and ____ will adopt it next quarter.
The blank stands alone for additional plural stores, so 'others' is required.
The engineer performed ____ test at a lower temperature to verify the result.
'Test' is singular countable and an additional test is meant, so 'another' is required.
The warranty does not cover damage caused by misuse or ____ external factors.
'External factors' is plural, so 'other' correctly precedes the noun phrase.
Some invoices were paid electronically; ____ were settled by bank transfer.
No noun follows the blank, and a plural set of invoices is meant, so 'others' is required.
The branch manager hired ____ assistant to handle the increased volume of customer calls.
'Assistant' is singular countable and one additional assistant is meant, so 'another' is required.
The brochure lists hotel rates, transportation options, and ____ travel information.
'Travel information' is uncountable, so 'other' is the correct determiner.
Several team members will present today, and ____ will speak at tomorrow's session.
The blank stands alone for additional plural team members, so 'others' is required.
The supplier offered ____ model with a longer warranty and lower energy consumption.
'Model' is singular countable and a different model is meant, so 'another' is required.
The committee discussed staffing levels and ____ operational concerns during the meeting.
'Operational concerns' is plural, so 'other' is required.
Some packages were delivered before noon; ____ arrived later in the afternoon.
The blank is a standalone plural pronoun for additional packages, so 'others' is required.
The accountant opened ____ spreadsheet to check the figures independently.
'Spreadsheet' is singular countable and a separate additional spreadsheet is meant, so 'another' is required.
The company plans to expand into retail and ____ markets next year.
'Markets' is plural, so 'other' correctly modifies it.
Several proposals met the technical requirements, but ____ exceeded the available budget.
The blank stands alone for additional plural proposals, so 'others' is required.
The laboratory ordered ____ refrigerator after the existing unit reached full capacity.
'Refrigerator' is singular countable and one additional unit is meant, so 'another' is required.
